title: Food Classification 61
notes: CC0 AIcrowd/Kaggle single-food classification source with 61 classes and train_img.csv labels; useful public-safe fill for weak global dishes/ingredients.

title: Desi Food Dataset Annotated
notes: MIT YOLO source for samosa, fried rice, curry, and ice cream style classes; small but bbox-native.

title: Popular Street Foods
notes: MIT 20-class street-food imagefolder; audit must check low file-size/resolution and overlap before inclusion.

title: CNFOOD-241
notes: Strong 241-class Chinese dish source with 191k images, but original license is CC BY-NC 3.0 and includes ChineseFoodNet-derived images; CPU audit only, private/noncommercial gate.

title: UEC-Food256
notes: 256-class food localization reference with category.txt and bb_info.txt; audit structure/counts, but default training blocked until license is clarified.

title: 16 Famous Chinese Dishes
notes: Kaggle metadata is Apache-2.0 but description warns some images may have copyright restrictions; audit only, do not train by default until resolved.

title: Common Chinese Food
notes: Only five classes, 32x32 and augmented per description; audit for evidence but likely too low quality for default training.

title: DimSum50
notes: Promising 50-class/28,884-image dim sum source, but Kaggle file listing shows flat images without an obvious label map; keep out of audit until class mapping is proven.
